facts.fact: The commune of Owendo signed an agreement with the Direction générale des Impôts on 2026-04-29 to implement the national Digitax application for municipal taxes; implementation is announced, one commune named.
Digitax is the Direction générale des Impôts' platform; the DGI will align the Owendo municipal agents' taxpayer directory with its own and parameterise the forms, per the 2026-04-29 agreement.
Owendo and the DGI signed the Digitax partnership on 2026-04-29, with payment by bank transfer and mobile money and automatic taxpayer certificates planned.

systems.tiers: national tax platform; agreed for Owendo commune's municipal taxes (2026-04-29)
